verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents Insights as a server-side analysis of production traffic. It covers aggregated query statistics, top queries ranked by performance metric, failing query patterns, resource anomalies and schema recommendations, and metric graphs live on their own dashboard tabs. A hands-on user independently confirms the Insights tab surfaced missing indexes that sped up queries. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the dashboard Insights view itself (the cited docs are mostly the CLI insights page), and explicit evidence of slow-query drill-down in the UI.
